calls.video_title: BUYING The Dip in 4 Stocks Before 2027
calls.stance_flip: Was UNCERTAIN on 3 Oct; now BUY - platform has evolved; down 35% in a year.
calls.price_at_call: No stated price; 'could be a $100 stock by end of 2026' (stated)
calls.thesis: BUY - FLIP from UNCERTAIN (3 Oct): evolved beyond meme trading into a diversified financial platform; edge score 77, down 35% in 12 months, EPS $2.93 next year (+~40%), forward P/E 27.7, PEG under 1; looking to sell the $70 put expiring 18 Dec for ~$300 premium.
calls.base_case: Revenue growing; adjusted EBITDA at all-time high, operating margins 45.7%.
calls.bull_case: Younger customers deepen relationships - retirement, cash management - over time.
calls.bear_case: Sensitive to trading activity and market sentiment.

calls.video_title: Interesting Update for Robinhood Stock Investors | HOOD Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: Reiterates his hold: not a buying opportunity yet — record trading and prediction markets (+500%) show growth, but at $91.60 the price already reflects those prospects and more.
calls.base_case: Fair value $58 vs $91.60 — overvalued; 20% EPS growth over coming years looks reasonable.
calls.bull_case: Agentic trading ($250M already allocated) and new features keep engagement and account growth rising.
calls.bear_case: Cyclical: crypto revenue plunged 55% to $120M as activity tracked Bitcoin's 2026 drop, and trading collapses when markets fall.
